Method of Attack: Malspam campaign using romantic and endearing email subjects with ZIP attachments containing obfuscated JavaScript files that execute PowerShell commands to download and run malware
PowerShell command downloads krablin.exe malware and executes it
krablin.exe copies itself to %UserProfile%\[number]\winsvcs.exe and downloads five other malware samples
Resulting malware cocktail includes GandCrab ransomware, Monero XMRig miner, and Phorpiex spambot
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by use of PowerShell and %UserProfile% path)
Attack Vector: Malspam emails with ZIP attachments containing malicious JavaScript files
Indicators of Compromise: Malware file krablin.exe downloaded from slpsrgpsrhojifdij.ru
